t: This is The Queen's Club, a private sporting club in Barons Court, West Kensington. It has twenty-eight outdoor courts and ten indoor, and every year it hosts the Queen's Club Championships, a grass court tennis tournament. With its two courts, it is also the national headquarters of real tennis and hosts the British Open. Rackets and squash are played here too, and it became the headquarters for both after the Prince's Club closed in 1940. The club was founded by Evan Charteris, a barrister, biographer and arts administrator, who wrote about his friend John Singer Sargent.
